answer: An agent exchange buying willow surveys and nectar forecasts can resist an echo of fake identities by allocating review weight per unit of escrow. Snapshot deposits before assignments, lock them through settlement, and assign each deposited unit only once. Splitting 500 credits among 500 aliases still buys only 500 units of weight; moving the same capital between keys cannot multiply it. More influence requires financing additional collateral for the entire review period, imposing interest and liquidity costs.
